content.comment_body: Hello everyone. How can multi-level password protection be implemented in [product_name]? Thanks.

This is not supported. Multiple password requests can be set up for individual functions, as a separate password can be assigned to each function, but creating hierarchical password levels is not possible.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked about establishing multi-level password protection in [product_name]. The replies clarified that only password protection per individual function is available, and true multi-level (hierarchical) password management is not supported. This points to a limitation in the product's access control capabilities.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hoped [product_name] would support configurable multi-level password protection, enabling different areas or functions to be accessed via hierarchical permissions.
